name: It looks like only the pumpkins are U-pick,
description: In Camino, CA, It looks like only the pumpkins are U-pick, raises Apples, Pears, Pumpkins, Corn, and Christmas trees on a working farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through autumn and summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
